verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework and component toolkit; it does not host or analyze a user's data, so in-product AI-generated insights from user data is outside its category. Its AI-related evidence covers AGENTS.md scaffolding, llms-full.txt and Markdown docs for coding agents, and server-rendered SVG charts. None of that is AI-generated insight from data, so it does not make this axis apply.
